ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings drive design and viability prediction
ranked.summary: Learned protein representations are increasingly coupled to generative design and prediction across peptides, capsids, and binding pockets.

ranked.headline: Single-cell response benchmarks expose metric artifacts and weak deep-model gains
ranked.summary: Scaling, interpretability, and perturbation studies now test whether reported single-cell model performance survives rigorous evaluation.

ranked.headline: Split design and multimodal fusion reshape biological prediction benchmarks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair biologically grounded data splits with multimodal fusion to curb shortcut learning in biomedical prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned sequence models predict splicing and piRNA-guided RNA cleavage outcomes
ranked.summary: Sequence models now condition on splicing factor expression and guide-target positional features to predict RNA processing outcomes.

ranked.headline: Inferring resistance, unseen phage diversity, and variant abundance from sequence data
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published method push sequence and spectra data toward cheaper, surveillance-scale inference.

ranked.headline: Computational models resolve tumor cell states across single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Single-cell, spatial, and cell-free plasma profiling are now paired with computational inference of tumor states and regulatory networks.

ranked.headline: Haplotype, path and repeat models are moving beyond fixed reference coordinates
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one 2026 publication apply haplotype, path and repeat representations to phasing, variant calling and population structure.

ranked.headline: Learned models classify biological sequences for function, taxonomy, and phenotype
ranked.summary: Alignment-free k-mer and language-model approaches aim to scale sequence classification to partial genomes and hundreds of thousands of proteins.

ranked.headline: Assembly-free inference of resistance determinants, plasmid hosts, and CRISPR arrays
ranked.summary: Short-read, nanopore, and foundation-model workflows now infer resistance and host attribution directly from raw reads rather than assembled genomes.

ranked.headline: ML pipelines pair model design with safeguards against bias and noise in biological data
ranked.summary: Sparse, noisy biological datasets make estimator bias and overfitting consequential, prompting explicit safeguards in new learning frameworks.

ranked.headline: Mechanical models link cell-junction, nuclear, and tissue forces to cell states
ranked.summary: Mechanical models now yield predictive readouts for EMT, nuclear remodeling, and corneal epithelial stratification.

ranked.headline: Software tools for comparing, imputing, and annotating genomic and epigenomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe new tools for ChIP-seq peak comparison, methylation imputation, and SNP genotyping curation.

ranked.headline: Functional variant data and ancestry-aware tools refine variant-to-phenotype inference
ranked.summary: Calibrated reclassification of VUS and ancestry-specific predictor assessment test the clinical validity of genotype-to-phenotype inference.

ranked.headline: Graph models infer drug and gene interactions from multimodal biological features
ranked.summary: Foundation-model embeddings and graph transformers now target zero-shot and drug-based split interaction prediction across biological networks.

ranked.headline: Directed, time-varying and critical brain dynamics as candidate connectivity markers
ranked.summary: Directionality, criticality and redundancy are now quantified as candidate brain markers, each within distinct modalities and analysis frameworks.

ranked.headline: Learned representations pairing scRNA-seq with scATAC-seq, spatial, and histology data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend multimodal Transformer and autoencoder architectures to single-cell batch correction and spatial expression supervision.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer atomic coordinates and missing tilts from cryo-EM/ET density
ranked.summary: Experimental cryo-EM and cryo-ET density now serves as direct input for generative and supervised models that complete or model macromolecular structure.

ranked.headline: Ligand input format and charge affect protein-ligand co-folding predictions
ranked.summary: Recent works add quantum descriptors, public-data GNNs, and deep target-prediction tools to ADMET, transporter, and polypharmacology modeling.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale and community-model approaches link microbial genes to host outcomes
ranked.summary: Expanded genome collections and host-linked multi-omics now enable testing microbial gene function against host phenotypes and probiotic efficacy.

ranked.headline: New methods impose structure on spatial and single-cell transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Imaging-based and sequencing-based spatial platforms now yield benchmark datasets and alignment tools that demand explicit cell-type and neighborhood modeling.

ranked.headline: Models infer regulatory, driver and repair consequences of somatic mutations in cancer
ranked.summary: Cohorts of 560 breast cancer genomes and over 210,000 patients now support mutation-resolved inference of tumor genome function.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict biomolecular evolution, binding, and dynamics from data
ranked.summary: February 2026 preprints and publications test learned models on epistasis, all-atom dynamics, and paratope prediction.

ranked.headline: Community curation and multi-species annotation expose recurrent annotation errors
ranked.summary: Comparative genomics depends on annotation accuracy, and new curated and multi-species annotation resources address this directly.

ranked.headline: Reference-free and software-based analysis of single-molecule microscopy data
ranked.summary: Reference-free MINFLUX analysis, MATLAB single-molecule tracking, and nanopore peptide classification advance quantitative single-molecule readouts.

ranked.headline: Fluctuations and protease competition shape gene network oscillations and patterning
ranked.summary: Gene regulatory networks are being analyzed beyond mean-field kinetics to resolve how noise, feedback and competition govern dynamics.

ranked.headline: Simulations probe nucleosome, capsid, and membrane mechanics and viral genome organization
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one publication apply coarse-grained and molecular dynamics simulations to nucleosome, HIV-1 capsid, endophilin, and HBV assemblies.

ranked.headline: MD reveals envelope lipid and protonation effects on transport and polymyxin penetration
ranked.summary: Recent all-atom and long-timescale MD studies probe bacterial envelope and channel behaviour at molecular resolution, linking charge state and asymmetry to…

ranked.headline: Integrating experimental restraints into AlphaFold, Rosetta, and MD modeling workflows
ranked.summary: Recent work couples ion mobility, chemical shift, and QM/MM reference data directly to structural prediction and simulation models.

ranked.headline: Long-read and hybrid pipelines benchmark variant detection across platforms
ranked.summary: Long-read and hybrid sequencing now enable benchmarked small, structural, somatic and rare variant detection against reference standards.

ranked.headline: Causal genetics and metabolic modeling prioritize context-specific disease targets
ranked.summary: Integrative causal, metabolic, and multi-omic frameworks now nominate heterogeneous, context-specific candidates across aging and liver disease.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models are predicting siRNA, antisense, and RNA structure outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent deep learning and LLM benchmarks extend computational prediction of silencing oligonucleotide efficacy and RNA structure.

ranked.headline: Refined tools for RNA-seq artifacts, transcript assembly and tRNA modification mapping
ranked.summary: Recent tools reanalyze scRNA-seq empty droplets, RNA-seq normalization offsets, long-read assemblies and tRNA modification reads.

ranked.headline: Browser and CLI tools for alignment, regulatory motif, and phenotype-network analysis
ranked.summary: New tools place command-line and browser interfaces over alignment, regulatory, phenotype and epigenomic analyses.

ranked.headline: Host HLA and archaic introgression enter explicit immune and pathogen sequence models
ranked.summary: Current work links archaic introgression and HLA variation to immune and pathogen sequence modeling under explicit assumptions.

ranked.headline: ML and LLM Tools Standardize and Extract Biological Data for Reproducible Analysis
ranked.summary: Open-weight LLMs and standardized ontologies are making heterogeneous biological metadata, literature and benchmarks machine-actionable.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic, acquisition-aware software for DIA, retention time, spectra and abundance
ranked.summary: Recent tools model acquisition and measurement processes explicitly while targeting throughput at scales up to 368 million spectra.

ranked.headline: Mutation-selection and fluctuating interactions set evolutionary and ecological equilibria
ranked.summary: Recent February 2026 preprints give analytical results on quasispecies localization, fluctuating-interaction ecology, and fitness-landscape drift.

ranked.headline: LLM agents and knowledge graphs convert biomedical data into provenance-traced claims
ranked.summary: Agentic and knowledge-graph tools now enforce provenance and audit gates on biomedical claims across pathways, drug safety and target-disease evidence.

ranked.headline: Hardware and heuristic acceleration of peptide search, graph alignment and mRNA design
ranked.summary: Sequence-analysis workloads in proteomics, graph alignment and mRNA design are being accelerated through hardware co-design and fast heuristics.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics of Leishmania RBPs links regulators to stage and stress responses
ranked.summary: Field-derived Plasmodium genomes and a 33-strain Leishmania RBP survey extend comparative genomics to natural and multi-strain samples.
